name: visio-scientific-illustrator-test
description: Test revisioned quality workflows for editable scientific figures in visible Microsoft Visio.

interface.shortDescription: Test tool-driven quality gates for editable figures in visible Microsoft Visio.
interface.longDescription: Controls only a Test Edition-owned visible Microsoft Visio process through an isolated local C# COM bridge. It preserves editable native shapes, text, paths, glued connectors, groups, layers, containers, SceneGraphs, scientific components and ShapeSheet metadata while adding revisioned regional review and correction workflows.
defaultPrompt: 使用 Visio Scientific Illustrator Test，在可见的 Microsoft Visio 页面中逐步重绘可编辑科学插图。
Recreate this reference figure with the Visio Scientific Illustrator Test quality workflow.
